The original {{GameCategory|ofp|link= y}} series for PC created the new benchmark in modern realistic military gaming and included {{GameCategory|ofp|link= y}} in 2001 and [[{{ofpr}}]] in 2002.
The games won many awards and were later distributed in one box by Codemasters as Operation Flashpoint: Game of the Year (GOTY) Edition.

Since then, the story goes on&hellip;

<!--
Next came {{GameCategory|ofpe|link= y}} for the Xbox which was released in 2005.
Unlike many PC game conversions, all of the in-game functionality of the PC version was provided in this release, which included modified versions of the original {{ofp}} and {{ofpr}} campaigns in upgraded game engine with full Xbox Live multiplayer support.

And in late 2006 and early 2007 {{Name|bi}}'s new {{arma1}} came on the market. After many years of waiting, the fans finally had their true successor to {{ofp}}.

In summer 2009, {{GameCategory|arma2|link= y}}, the next game in the {{arma}} series, was released worldwide.

On the 12th of September 2013, {{GameCategory|arma3|link= y}} was released as [[Steam]]-exclusive.
-->

Before {{ofp}}, other games were produced by {{Name|bi}} and the Španěl brothers - see the {{Link|Category:Before Flashpoint‎}} category.
